notes:
Added:
- Export window for every batch tool (Render H264/H265, Concat, Intro/Outro/Logo, Chroma Key, Split, Trim, Loop): "Render All" (Split All, Loop All, Start Concat) or ▶ on one row now opens an Export window — like a video editor's — where you choose the output folder, how many files run at once and, for the re-encoding tools, codec, Landscape/Portrait, resolution, bitrate/fps and the aspect-ratio option. A summary shows exactly what will be rendered; Export stays disabled until an output folder is chosen.
- Download Video uses the same window: "Download All" or ⬇ on one row opens it to pick the output folder, quality, Prefer H.264 and concurrency.
- "Video tutorial" button in the header opens the full YouTube walkthrough (https://youtu.be/e_2hA7FT6i0).
- Every tool's Guide (?) now has a "Watch the video tutorial" button that opens the video right at that tool's chapter.

Changed:
- Tool pages are simpler: they show only the tool's own inputs (media assets, green screen, split/trim/loop settings, video source) and the file table, with Start All / Stop All in the table's header next to Clear All and Add Files.
- Concat's output file name is now entered in the Export window (the separate "Output Video Name" popup is gone).

Fixed:
- Chroma Key "Auto" colour detection no longer erases the white, black and grey parts of the overlay (e.g. white text and black outlines of a subscribe-button clip): the similarity is now computed from the detected key colour instead of a fixed 0.4.
- Super Live Stream: the ⚠ badge for skipped videos disappeared about a second after it appeared; the error list now stays until the thread is started again.
- Chroma Key settings no longer misalign when a translated label wraps onto two lines (e.g. Vietnamese) at the default window size.
